questions.label: What are you planning to build?
questions.help: Nestora currently synthesizes complete plans for independent houses on private plots.

options.label: A new independent house on my private plot (Bungalow / Row House / Villa)
Structural extension or renovation of an existing house
Interior design or fit-out for an apartment / flat

questions.clarify_if: Selected 'renovation' or 'flat_interior' routes to priority waitlist for Phase 2.

questions.label: Where is your plot located and what is the street access?
questions.help: Street width determines your permissible floor area (FSI) under municipal bylaws.

options.label: Narrow lane or gaothan road (Less than 9 meters / under 30 ft)
Standard residential street (9 to 12 meters / 30 to 40 ft)
Wide municipal avenue (Over 12 meters / 40+ ft)

questions.clarify_if: Road width < 9m caps suburban Mumbai FSI to 1.00 base without premium.

questions.label: What are your exact plot dimensions and orientation?
questions.help: Enter front road width in feet, plot depth in feet, and road facing direction.

options.label: North-facing plot
East-facing plot
South-facing plot
West-facing plot

questions.clarify_if: Frontage width < 20 ft triggers narrow-lot linear template.

questions.label: Do you know your plot's soil and ground conditions?
questions.help: If you don't have a soil bore report yet, we will safely apply Mumbai municipal standard engineering defaults.

options.label: I don't know — use standard Mumbai municipal defaults (Basalt/Murrum strata, Zone III seismic, 44 m/s wind)
Expansive black cotton / soft clay soil (Requires raft or under-reamed pile foundation)
Solid rocky basalt ledge (Shallow isolated column footings)
Near coastal high-tide line or creek buffer (CRZ setback zone)

questions.clarify_if: Selected 'coastal_crz' triggers MCZMA environmental buffer check.

questions.label: How many storeys do you want to build, and what parking is needed?
questions.help: Total building height for low-rise residential is typically capped at 10 meters (G+2).

options.label: Single floor (Ground only / Bungalow) with front car porch
Ground + 1 upper floor (Duplex) with 1 car porch
Ground stilt covered parking (2 cars) + 2 upper residential floors
Ground + 2 full residential floors with open front parking

questions.clarify_if: G+2 requires 230x380mm column sections instead of standard 230x230mm.

questions.label: Who will be living in this home?
questions.help: Helps us size bedrooms, calculate bathroom counts, and plan daily living circulation.

options.label: 1 or 2 Working Adults
3+ Adults / Joint Family
Senior Citizens / Parents
Children (Toddlers or School-age)
Family Pets (Dogs / Cats)

questions.clarify_if: Kids present increases balcony and stair railing height from 1000mm to 1100mm with vertical balusters < 100mm gap.

questions.label: Do any family members have knee pain or mobility challenges?
questions.help: Ensures step-free circulation, wider doorways, and dedicated ground-floor suites.

options.label: Yes — requires a ground-floor master suite, zero-step thresholds, and wider doors
Yes — planned for wheelchair accessibility and future elevator / lift shaft
No mobility constraints — comfortable with regular multi-storey stairs

questions.clarify_if: Triggers 900mm clear door openings and eliminates sunken shower curbs.

questions.label: How much does your family work or study from home?
questions.help: Determines whether to allocate dedicated quiet study rooms or integrated workstations.

options.label: Daily intensive remote work — need a dedicated quiet office / study with video call acoustic privacy
Moderate / student study — quiet desk nook inside bedrooms is sufficient
Minimal / rare — no specialized study room needed

questions.clarify_if: Adds dedicated 100 sqft study room on quiet first floor.

questions.label: What are your culinary habits and kitchen prep preferences?
questions.help: Tailors ventilation exhaust, wet/dry utility separation, and sunlight orientation.

options.label: Vegetarian household — open-concept modular kitchen connected to dining
Non-vegetarian household — prefer an enclosed wet preparation utility / scullery
Jain dietary household — strict Chauvihar daytime sunlight, direct morning sun, sealed dry store

questions.clarify_if: Jain preference mandates window orientation in East or South-East.

questions.label: What spiritual spaces and social hosting capacity do you need?
questions.help: Ensures appropriate temple/prayer room zoning and guest accommodation.

options.label: Dedicated traditional Mandir / Puja room in auspicious quadrant
Compact prayer alcove or wall mandir in living area
Clear prayer area oriented towards Qibla with dedicated ablution (wudu) zone
Frequent festive hosting — need living/dining rooms that can open up into one grand space

questions.clarify_if: Enforces mandatory separation between mandir walls and toilet plumbing.

questions.label: How strictly should traditional placement rules (Vaastu, Feng Shui, Islamic, Biophilic) be followed?
questions.help: Building codes and structural safety always override traditions. Choose your compliance tier.

options.label: Strict Traditional Vaastu Shastra (No compromise on kitchen SE, master SW, puja NE, open center)
Balanced & Practical (Follow core orientations where feasible, prioritize modern flow and sunlight)
Modern Biophilic & Climatic (Prioritize daylight, cross-ventilation, and green views over cardinal dogma)
Neutral / Modernist (Pure functional architecture without traditional astrological rules)

questions.clarify_if: Strict setting penalizes solutions deviating from canonical directional padas.

questions.label: What are your 5-to-10 year future expansion plans?
questions.help: Structural columns, stairs, and slab cutouts can be pre-engineered today to save major reconstruction costs later.

options.label: Planning to add a future upper floor for rental income (Needs external or semi-private staircase)
Planning a future elevator / pneumatic home lift for old age
Rooftop terrace garden or complete solar panel array
No future additions — final complete structure as built

questions.clarify_if: Future rental floor switches internal stair to external dog-leg stair.

questions.label: What is your target construction budget (excluding land)?
questions.help: Does not include plot purchase cost. Determines material finish grades and structural specification tiers.

options.label: Economy / Value (₹18L to ₹28L / ₹1,600-₹1,900 per sqft) — Vitrified 2x2 tiles, basic paint, standard fittings
Standard Quality (₹30L to ₹48L / ₹2,100-₹2,600 per sqft) — Large format tiles, premium paint, UPVC windows
Premium Luxury (₹50L+ / ₹3,000-₹4,500+ per sqft) — Italian marble, teak joinery, acoustic glazing, VRV AC

questions.clarify_if: Calculates realistic low/expected/high BOQ breakdown matching regional rates.

questions.label: Tell us anything else in your own words (lifestyle habits, pet needs, aesthetic wishes, family rituals)
questions.help: Feel free to write in Hindi, Hinglish, or English. Our language parser extracts special lifestyle constraints.
questions.clarify_if: Mentions keywords like 'piano', 'puja bell', 'terrace garden', 'dog wash' to flag custom design touches.
